sites.source: http://www.casscountynd.gov/departments/administration/county-park-rates-rules-regulations as read 2026-10-16 (site counts quoted under hookups)

values.note: Reserve through Cass County's online reservation; unreserved sites are first come, first served. A stay is limited to 14 days with 7 days off between stays (the break may be waived if sites are free). Check-in 2 pm, check-out noon. Changes are free; cancelling costs at least $10, one night's fee within 3-14 days of arrival and the whole fee within 2 days. The camp host handles changes and cancellations.

booking.source: http://www.casscountynd.gov/departments/administration/county-park-rates-rules-regulations as read 2026-10-16 ('Reservations are required to ensure a site upon arrival. If there are no reservations, campsites will be available on a first come, first served basis.', 'Reservations are limited to 14 days with 7 days off between periods. The 7-day period may be waived based on availability. Check-in time is 2:00 PM and check-out time is noon.', 'The maximum advanced booking allowed is 120 days prior to the date of arrival.', cancellation policy)

values.note: Cass County: electric sites $20 a day, full hookup $25; tents $10. Read 2026-10-16.

fees.source: http://www.casscountynd.gov/departments/administration/county-park-rates-rules-regulations as read 2026-10-16 ('$10 per day for tents; $20 per day for electrical sites; $25 per day for full hook-up sites')

note: Cass County park on Brewer Lake near Erie: camp host May-Sep, boat launch, swim beach and store. --Claude

flags: WATERFRONT RE-AUDIT -> recommend lakefront -> lakeview. On Esri z19 imagery the RV area sits in the middle of the north-shore open ground, north of the campground's own lower loop road (about 47.0996,-97.4138); the shore below that road carries a continuous shrub/reed fringe and the road is ~20-30 m from the waterline, so no pad reaches the water over open ground without crossing the loop road (AWH 2026-11-01: a campground's own loop road blocks on-water). The open shoreline is the swim beach (day use, ~47.0995,-97.4120) and the west point (47.0991,-97.4152), which holds picnic shelters and tables on open lawn, not identifiable RV pads; the stored evidence's 'west point sites at the waterline' could not be tied to electric sites or numbers. No county site map could be read (403), so no site numbers can be named; per the rule the value goes down to the view the open north-shore ground supports.
